Package dev.px.core.math

Class Box

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.math.Box
public final class Box extends Object
An immutable axis-aligned bounding box in world space.

What Render.box(...) draws and what an adapter converts a game bounding box into. Bounds are normalised at construction, so min is always below max whichever way round the corners were given.
